**Connecting concepts of work**

I’m thinking about how the concept of an occupation combines with cycles, leading to the idea of a seasonal job. Perhaps this connects to the "rat race," which brings to mind that grey, small animal scurrying about. It also makes me reflect on how fast-paced life can feel, almost like a race. So, it seems the term "rat race" ties into themes like occupation, repetition, and the frantic nature of work life.
